script.title: THE APARTMENT TOUR
script.story_hook: Let's tour a bright two-bedroom apartment before it's gone.
script.intro_zh: 趁還沒人租走，來參觀一間明亮的兩房。
script.welcome_en: Welcome to today's apartment tour! Bring your questions.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎參加今天的看屋之旅！記得帶著問題。
script.outro: You just heard a full apartment tour. Well done!
script.outro_zh: 你剛聽完整段看屋對話。很棒！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the useful lines together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟讀這些實用的句子。
script.char_a_description: a young woman in her mid twenties with shoulder-length straight black hair, a slim build, wearing a mustard cardigan over a plain white tee, blue jeans, and clean white canvas sneakers
script.char_b_description: a cheerful middle-aged Latina woman with short curly salt-and-pepper hair, an average build, wearing a teal blazer over a cream blouse, black slacks, low block heels, and a lanyard ID badge

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm here for the two o'clock tour.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm hɪr fɚ ðə tuː‿əˈklɑk ˈtʊr/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我是來參加兩點看屋的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great! I'm Priya. Follow me, it's upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt aɪm ˈpriːjə ˈfɑloʊ mi ɪts ˌʌpˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 太好了！我是普里雅。跟我來，在樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lobby looks really nice and bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɑbi lʊks ˈrɪli naɪs‿n‿braɪt/
dialogue.zh: 大廳看起來又漂亮又明亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks. It was repainted just last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks ɪt wəz ˌriː‿ˈpeɪntɪd dʒʌst læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，上個月才重新粉刷過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, which unit are we seeing first?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɪtʃ ˈjunɪt ɑr wi ˈsiɪŋ fɚst/
dialogue.zh: 那我們先看哪一間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unit 4B. It's the one with the balcony.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjunɪt ˈfɔrˈbi ɪts ði wʌn wɪð ðə ˈbælkəni/
dialogue.zh: 4B室，就是有陽台的那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, the light in here is lovely.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðə laɪt ɪn hɪr ɪz ˈlʌvli/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這裡的光線真讓人喜歡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: South-facing windows. It stays warm all winter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaʊθ ˌfeɪsɪŋ ˈwɪndoʊz ɪt steɪz wɔrm ɔl ˈwɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 窗戶朝南，整個冬天都很暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love these wood floors. Are they real?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðiz wʊd flɔrz ɑr ðeɪ riəl/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這木地板，是真的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, refinished last year. No carpet here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˌriːˈfɪnɪʃt læst jɪr noʊ ˈkɑrpɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 對，去年重新打磨過，這裡沒有地毯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice. Um, how many bedrooms does it have?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs ʌm haʊ ˈmɛni ˈbɛdˌrumz dʌz ɪt hæv/
dialogue.zh: 不錯。呃，它有幾間臥室？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two, plus this little room for an office.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː plʌs ðɪs ˈlɪtl rum fɔr‿ən ˈɔfɪs/
dialogue.zh: 兩間，外加一間小書房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect for working from home, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɚfɪkt fɚ ˈwɚkɪŋ frʌm hoʊm ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實說，太適合在家工作了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lots of people use it that way.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɑts əv ˈpipəl juz ɪt ðæt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 很多租戶都這樣用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The kitchen is smaller than I hoped.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ɪz ˈsmɔlɚ ðæn aɪ hoʊpt/
dialogue.zh: 廚房比我預期的小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But see? The fridge stays and it's new.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt si ðə frɪdʒ steɪz ænd ɪts nu/
dialogue.zh: 但你看，冰箱留下，而且是新機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh good. Does the rent include utilities?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ɡʊd dʌz ðə rɛnt ɪnˈklud jutɪlətiz/
dialogue.zh: 哦好。租金含水電費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Water and trash, yes. Electric is separate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɔtɚ ænd træʃ jɛs ɪˈlɛktrɪk ɪz ˈsɛpəreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 自來水和垃圾清運，電費另外算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. About how much is electric?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt əˈbaʊt haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ɪˈlɛktrɪk/
dialogue.zh: 了解。電費大概多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Around forty dollars for one person.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈraʊnd ˈfɔrdi ˈdɑlərz fɚ wʌn ˈpɚsən/
dialogue.zh: 一個人大概四十塊左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's reasonable. Is parking included, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈrizənəbl̩ ɪz ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪnˈkludɪd tu/
dialogue.zh: 很合理。也附停車位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is. One spot, right behind the building.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz wʌn spɑt raɪt bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，一個車位，就在大樓後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that spot had a car in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðæt spɑt hæd ə kɑr ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那個車位上停著一台車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's a guest space. Sorry!
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ðæts ə ɡɛst speɪs ˈsɑri/
dialogue.zh: 哦不，那是訪客車位，抱歉！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So where would I actually park?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wɛr wʊd aɪ ˈæktʃuəli pɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 那我到底要停哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check... yes, spot twelve is yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk jɛs spɑt twɛlv ɪz jɔrz/
dialogue.zh: 我查一下……是的，十二號位是你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew. Okay, what about laundry?
dialogue.phonetic: /fju oʊˈkeɪ wʌt əˈbaʊt ˈlɔndri/
dialogue.zh: 呼。好，那洗衣間呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two machines downstairs, two dollars each.
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː məˈʃinz ˌdaʊnˈstɛrz tu ˈdɑlərz itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 樓下有兩台，每次兩塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need quarters? I never carry them.
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ˈkwɔrtərz aɪ ˈnɛvɚ ˈkæri ðəm/
dialogue.zh: 要準備硬幣嗎？我身上從不帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They take cards now. Much easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ teɪ kɑrdz naʊ mʌtʃ ˈizijɚ/
dialogue.zh: 現在刷卡就行，方便多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more thing. Can I have a cat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr θɪŋ kæn aɪ hæv ə kæt/
dialogue.zh: 還有一件事，我可以養貓嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cats are fine. There's a small pet fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæts ɑr faɪn ðɛrz ə smɔl pɛt fi/
dialogue.zh: 貓可以，只是有小額寵物費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much? I have one old tabby.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ aɪ hæv wʌn oʊld ˈtæbi/
dialogue.zh: 多少錢？我家有隻老虎斑貓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty-five a month, plus a deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti faɪv ə mʌnθ plʌs ə dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一個月二十五，外加押金。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, that works for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt wɜrks fɚ mi/
dialogue.zh: 好，這我可以接受。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lease is twelve months, starting in October.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lis ɪz twɛlv mʌnθs ˈstɑrtɪŋ ɪn ɑkˈtoʊbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 租約一年，從十月開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I move in mid-September, though?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ muv ɪn mɪd səpˈtɛmbɚ ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過，我可以九月中搬進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Um, 4B's open now, but 2A needs repairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈfɔrˈbiz ˈoʊpən naʊ bʌt ˈteɪˈeɪ nidz rɪˈpɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 呃，4B現在空著，但2A還要修。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What kind of repairs? Like, how long?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt kaɪnd əv rɪˈpɛrz laɪk haʊ lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 修什麼？大概要多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new dishwasher. Two weeks, maybe three.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə nuː ˈdɪʃwɑʃɚ tu wiːks ˈmeɪbi θri/
dialogue.zh: 換新洗碗機，兩到三週。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather not wait. My lease ends soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər nɑt weɪt maɪ lis ɛndz suːn/
dialogue.zh: 我不想等，我現在的房子租期快到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then 4B is your best choice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈfɔrˈbi ɪz jɔr bɛst tʃɔɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那4B就是妳最好的選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The application fee is... forty dollars?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæˌæpləˈkeɪʃən fi ɪz ˈfɔrdi ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 申請費是……四十塊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it covers the credit check.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ˈkʌvɚz ðə ˈkrɛdɪt tʃɛk/
dialogue.zh: 對，那包含信用審查。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can two of us apply together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn tu əv ʌs əˈplaɪ təˈɡɛðɚ/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以兩人一起申請嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, one fee each, income rules apply.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr wʌn fi itʃ ˈɪnkʌm rulz əˈplaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，一人一費，收入要達標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My roommate earns plenty, so we're fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈrumˌmeɪt ɜrnz ˈplɛnti soʊ wir faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 我室友收入充裕，所以沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful. Want to start it today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl wɑnt tə stɑrt ɪt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。今天就要開始申請嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! What do I need to bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌt du aɪ nid tə brɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 要！我需要帶什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Photo ID and three months of pay stubs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ ˌaɪˈdi ænd θri mʌnθs əv peɪ stʌbs/
dialogue.zh: 附有照片的證件，還有三個月的薪資單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have both on my phone, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv boʊθ ɑn maɪ foʊn ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 其實兩者我手機裡都有。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Even better. The office has a printer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈivən ˈbɛtɚ ði ˈɔfɪs hæz ə ˈprɪntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 那更好，辦公室有列印機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. This feels kind of sudden.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt ðɪs filz kaɪnd əv ˈsʌdn/
dialogue.zh: 好。這感覺有點突然。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good sudden! Units like this go fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈsʌdn ˈjunɪts laɪk ðɪs ɡoʊ fæst/
dialogue.zh: 是好事！這種單位一下子就租光了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I peek in the closet? Just curious.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pik ɪn ðə ˈklɑzɪt dʒʌst ˈkjʊriəs/
dialogue.zh: 我可以看一下衣櫥嗎？有點好奇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Walk-in, and it has shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /əv ˈkɔrs wɑk ɪn ænd ɪt hæz ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 當然。走進去式的，還有層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm sold. Let's do the application.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪm soʊld lɛts du ði ˌæpləˈkeɪʃən/
dialogue.zh: 好，我決定了，來填申請表。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Awesome. Right this way, seats by the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔsəm raɪt ðɪs weɪ sits baɪ ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，這邊請，靠窗有座位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for all your patience today.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fɚ ɔl jɔr ˈpeɪʃəns təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你今天那麼有耐心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pleasure. Tea while we wait, maybe?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈplɛʒɚ ti waɪl wi weɪt ˈmeɪbi/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。等的時候來杯茶好嗎？

script.youtube_description:
「Is parking included?」想知道看屋時怎麼用英文問問題嗎？
這一集是一整段60句的看屋對話：水電費、停車位、寵物費、申請流程，全都聽得懂、學得會。

你會學到：
・ asks about utilities and parking（問水電與停車）
・ talking about the lease and move-in date（談租期與入住日）
・ filling an application（現場填申請表）

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，不用背，多聽就會用。

喜歡的話請訂閱，並按讚分享給正在找房的朋友！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en:
Can I have a cat? How much is electric? Learn the exact English you need at an apartment tour.
This episode is one full 60-line rental tour: utilities, parking, pet fees, repairs, and the application process.

You will hear:
・ polite questions about the unit
・ money and lease vocabulary in real conversation
・ natural small talk between renter and agent

The second half is line-by-line listening and repeat-after-me practice. No memorizing - just listen, and it sticks.

If you like it, subscribe and share with a friend who is apartment hunting!
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
看屋時只會說「很漂亮」嗎？
水電、停車、養寵物，用英文要怎麼問？
這一集帶大家走進一間待租的兩房公寓，從大廳一路看到廚房與衣櫥。

你會聽到：
🚪「Does the rent include utilities?」一題問清水電費
🅿️「So where would I actually park?」車位出狀況怎麼追問
🐈「Cats are fine. There's a small pet fee.」養寵條件一次懂
📝「Photo ID and three months of pay stubs.」申請要帶什麼

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 60句看屋對話，一句一句慢速重複，讓句子自然進到嘴裡。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。

願你下次看屋，從容開口，找到滿意的家。
script.thumbnail_action: gesturing around a sunny living room
